414e33a7ca.q: How should new apostille agents handle their first client calls to build confidence and credibility?
414e33a7ca.a: Never tell the client you are brand new. Instead, say 'Thank you so much. Let me write down exactly what you need. I'm with a customer and I'll get back to you in one hour.' This gives you time to research and figure out the answer while maintaining professional credibility. The book Jitters covers what to do and what to say during those first calls.

48a1fbffd2.q: What misinformation do people hear about becoming a notary and starting a notary business?
48a1fbffd2.a: During the pandemic, people were told that becoming a notary means you can make your own schedule, work when you want, and make a lot of money. This is not true. Your clients make your schedule, the Secretary of State is your boss because they approve or reject your submissions, and there is significant competition among notaries.
